Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London, UK strictly after 2026-10-14T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-15T23:00:00Z reaches or exceeds 21°C.
- "No": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London, UK strictly after 2026-10-14T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-15T23:00:00Z remains below 21°C.

Clarifications:
- "London, UK" refers to central London (approximately 51.51°N, 0.13°W); the representative station or grid point nearest to this coordinate is used.
- The temperature measured is the highest observed or reanalysis-derived 2 m air temperature across all hours of 15 October 2026 (UTC), i.e. the interval strictly after 2026-10-14T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-15T23:00:00Z.
